meta.title: An LOA preview for a vendor not in the award is refused

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Vendor is not part of this proposal”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: An LOA preview for a vendor not in the award is refused
